name: Kite Route Crossing
headline: Pennrose is building Kite Route Crossing, 50 income-restricted apartments for adults 55+ at 30% to 70% AMI in Downtown Superior. It is the town's first tax credit and first age-restricted rental community, and it won 2025 Round One federal 9% and state credits from CHFA.
why_it_matters: It shows how a 9% senior deal in a high-cost town with no prior LIHTC stock was closed by stacking Marshall Fire recovery money (CDBG-DR, a community foundation grant), Boulder County's new sales-tax housing fund and town fee relief on top of the credits.

status.label: Under construction (groundbreaking 2026-03-05); opening expected summer 2027
status.detail: Pennrose announced a groundbreaking on 2026-03-05 and named its equity investors and construction and permanent lenders, which indicates financing closed (inferred). Opening is expected in summer 2027. No public building permit record or lease-up information was found.

next_step: Watch for Pennrose leasing announcements and a certificate of occupancy for 2101 Old Rail Way ahead of the expected summer 2027 opening.

key_numbers.meaning: 44 one-bedroom and 6 two-bedroom units at 30%, 50%, 60% and 70% AMI.
About $16M over the 10-year credit period, plus $650,000 in state credit.
As Pennrose stated at groundbreaking (REBusiness reported $26.3M).

key_numbers.meaning: Up to $521,554 CDBG-DR (per the application), $500,000 from Community Foundation Boulder County, and $1,000,000 recommended from Boulder County's housing tax, plus town fee relief.

background.text: Pennrose first applied in 2024 Round One with 48 units and a $1,450,000 federal 9% request; it was not funded that round (inferred from the 2025 re-application). For 2025 it went to 50 units with more one-bedrooms and fewer two-bedrooms and adjusted the income mix.
The application says Pennrose negotiated a $350,000 reduction in the land price. Yellow Scene reported in March 2025 that the property was under contract; the seller and price are not public.

Per the application, Superior's Town Council unanimously approved a Planned Development amendment in March and a bundle of fee waivers and reductions in September of the year before the February 2025 application (inferred to be 2024).

In September 2025 the Town Council approved a resolution adopting the Kite Route pre-development agreement and a resolution approving a development agreement with Kite Route Crossing LLC. Resolution numbers are not shown in the town's action summary.

The application says CHFA and OEDIT invited the town to submit a full Prop 123 Land Banking application for the site. No award record was found, and Pennrose's groundbreaking release does not list Prop 123.
The Boulder County Housing Authority indicated interest in a special limited partnership to bring property tax and sales and use tax exemptions. Whether this was done at closing is not public.

The market study found all surveyed senior LIHTC properties above 98% occupancy and a 522-household waitlist at the newest senior project. The 50% and 60% AMI senior penetration rates (43.9% and 86.7%) are above CHFA's preferred threshold.

The building is designed beyond the 2021 IFC for fire resiliency, with fire-resistant exterior materials, full sprinklers and a planned defensible zone next to the site. The Marshall Fire destroyed 391 homes in Superior.

Amenities include a community room, fitness room, dog wash, package room, bike storage and a second-floor sun deck; units have in-unit washers and dryers and walk-in closets. EV charging is planned at 10 stalls.

discrepancies.text: CHFA lists the address as 0 Canary Lane, while Pennrose now gives 2101 Old Rail Way.
The 2025 application puts the town's fee waivers and reductions at about $767,000, while Yellow Scene reported an estimated rebate of about $725,000 (47% of permit and review fees).
Yellow Scene in March 2025 described 48 units (36 one-bedroom, 12 two-bedroom), while CHFA's award description and Pennrose list 50 units (44 one-bedroom, 6 two-bedroom).
Pennrose states a $26.35M development cost, while REBusiness reported $26.3M.
